method: Every row re-read on the seller's current pricing page (or the same source class it was originally collected from) by WebFetch on 2026-10-26. Status: confirmed = same price read today; changed = different price read today (previous kept as price_previous); unavailable = no longer listed (price cleared, delisted_as_of set); not_rechecked = no readable source today (price and as_of untouched, so staleness stays visible). Quotes are the exact price text read. Per-node prices divided by GPUs per node as noted.
